brand.name: FocusMatrix
brand.tagline: Decide more. Do less. Lead better.

ai.title: AI Co‑Pilot
ai.byok_desc: FocusMatrix never charges for AI. Paste your own Gemini, OpenAI or Anthropic API key — it is encrypted at rest and only used for your account.
ai.feature_triage: Smart triage: classify a task into Keep / Delegate / Drop with rationale
ai.feature_delegation: Delegation draft: one‑click goal, scope, resources and deadline hints
ai.feature_insights: Weekly insights: personalised coaching on your self‑check answers
ai.key_placeholder_set: Leave blank to keep existing key
ai.key_encrypted_notice: Your key will be encrypted with Laravel's app‑level cipher before saving.
ai.confirm_remove: Remove your API key? AI features will fall back to the free heuristic engine.
ai.enter_key_first: Enter your API key first (min 20 characters).

calendar.title: Calendar & focus time
calendar.subtitle: Deep‑work blocks protect the tasks only you should do. Meetings without decisions get flagged.
calendar.weak_meetings_sub: Meetings our auditor thinks you should cut, shorten or skip.
calendar.no_events: No events in the next 4 days.
calendar.connect_cta: Connect Google Calendar to unlock focus‑time blocking and the meeting auditor.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect the tools where your tasks and meetings really live.
integrations.google_desc: Auto‑block deep‑work time and audit upcoming meetings.
integrations.not_configured: Google OAuth is not configured on this server. Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.

landing.hero_sub: FocusMatrix is the operating system for managers who want to lead, not juggle tasks. Built on the Only-You-Principle: if someone else can do it at least as well, you shouldn't.
landing.principle_q: Can only I really do this?
landing.principle_sub: Every task gets routed into Keep, Delegate, or Drop. No more being a processor of other people's work.
landing.matrix_delegate_sub: Structured goal, frame, resources — no micromanagement
landing.matrix_drop_sub: Meetings without decisions. Reports without readers.
landing.feature_dashboard_d: Focus score, streaks and weekly clarity.
landing.feature_inbox_d: Every task forced through the Only-You question.
landing.feature_keep_d: Auto-tagged into the four Only-You categories.
landing.feature_delegate_d: Goal, frame, deadline, scope, resources, backing.
landing.feature_drop_d: Boldly kill meetings and reports that don't serve a goal.
landing.feature_selfcheck_d: Friday ritual. Did I focus on the few important decisions?
landing.feature_orgcheck_d: Who decides what. By when. Clear responsibilities.
landing.feature_ai_d: Smart triage suggestions and delegation drafts.
landing.footer_principle: If someone else can do it at least as well, I shouldn't.

dashboard.focus_score_sub: Share of time spent on Only-You tasks

task.title: Task
task.the_question: Can only I really do this?
task.question_sub: Answer honestly. Your time is the scarcest resource in the company.
task.answer_yes: Yes — only I can do this
task.yes_hint: This stays with you. We'll help you block focus time.
task.no_hint: You'll delegate this with a clear goal and frame — or drop it.
task.maybe_hint: The AI co-pilot will suggest a route based on your pattern.

delegate.title: Delegate task
delegate.goal: What does a good result look like?
delegate.goal_placeholder: A concrete, outcome-based goal the delegate can aim at.
delegate.to_placeholder: Pick the most suitable — not the most comfortable
delegate.inform_placeholder: People / teams to keep in the loop
delegate.resources_placeholder: Budget, tools, access, who to go to for help
delegate.no_micro_desc: I will not check in before the agreed cadence.
delegate.remember: Delegation means giving up responsibility — not throwing off work.

drop.title: Drop task
drop.serves_goal: Does it serve a clear goal?
drop.missing: Would anything be missing if we simply delete it?
drop.kill_list_sub: Tasks, meetings and reports you had the courage to remove

selfcheck.title: Weekly self-check
selfcheck.subtitle: Honest answers only. This is your Friday ritual.
selfcheck.q1: Which tasks did I do that others could do just as well?
selfcheck.q2: Where did I delegate too late or not at all?
selfcheck.q3: What can I consistently leave out next week?
selfcheck.q4: Did I focus on a few important decisions?

orgcheck.title: Organisation check
orgcheck.subtitle: Clarity is the best anti-chaos medicine.
orgcheck.reports: Are reports short and flowing bottom-up?
orgcheck.teams: Are teams small and capable of action?
